'''Transport Station 5''' was a part of the communication and transport system on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] before being destroyed in [[3956 BBY]] during the [[Destruction of Taris]]. It was constructed around the [[Promised Land]], the original colony site of Taris. Around [[3643 BBY]], an individual hired by the researcher [[Hacken Berge]] went to the remains of Transport Station 5 and found [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecordings]] of the history of the [[Promised Ones]], a group of [[Outcasts (Taris)|outcasts]] who had survived the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of Taris.
